lead: In 2022 NASA crashed a spacecraft called DART into a small asteroid and changed its path. This page shows how we could protect Earth.
try: Press Replay the impact, then move the sliders to change the asteroid and the warning time.
points: A small push given many years early is enough to make an asteroid miss Earth.
With little warning, you need a much bigger push.
Finding dangerous asteroids early is the most important part of protecting Earth.
